children: bioAffinity Technologies regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum $1.00 bid price and will remain listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market.
Nasdaq notified the company it had regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) and Listing Rule 5560(a).
The previously scheduled Nasdaq Hearings Panel hearing for Sept 8, 2026 was cancelled following the compliance determination.
The company’s common stock and warrants will continue trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under BIAF and BIAFW.
As of Sept 8, 2026 there were 1,166,625 outstanding shares and aggregate market value was about $10.4 million.
